title: AIDLC: AI-Driven Software Development Lifecycle
description: Set the vision and roadmap for Bread Financial's AI-driven development lifecycle, building a cross-functional team spanning engineering, risk, cyber, and architecture to deliver the company's first working proof of concept.

title: GenAI Quality Engineering & Test Data Management Portal
description: Upgraded Quality Engineering with GenAI-powered test case generation, tagging, and selective execution, then launched a Test Data Management portal processing hundreds of requests per month.

title: Mainframe-to-Cloud Migration
description: Stabilized systems after Bread Financial's largest migration of credit card processing off mainframe to Fiserv and Microsoft Azure, cutting Fiserv transaction volume 20-25% via API caching and circuit breakers.

title: BreadFinancial.com & NFLExtraPoints.com Launch
description: Delivered BreadFinancial.com and NFLExtraPoints.com on a new Adobe Experience Manager platform, anchoring the company's brand transformation and its first card program on the American Express network.

title: PartnerPortal
description: Delivered Bread Financial's Salesforce-based brand partner platform, growing adoption to over 100 active brands.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Rollout
description: Spearheaded a $3.5M MFA rollout at Nationwide, securing 1.5M+ online accounts.
